LAYERS = ['PHYSICAL_DATACENTER', 'HYPERVISOR', 'OS_PATCHING', 'RUNTIME', 'APPLICATION_CODE', 'DATA']


def responsibility_owner(layer, model):
    aws_layers = {'IaaS': 2, 'PaaS': 4, 'SaaS': 5}[model]
    return 'AWS' if LAYERS.index(layer) < aws_layers else 'CUSTOMER'

def is_fault_tolerant(nodes):
    return len({node['az'] for node in nodes}) >= 2

import re

DIRECTIONS = 'north|south|east|west|central|northeast|northwest|southeast|southwest'


def is_valid_region(code):
    return re.fullmatch(rf'[a-z]{{2}}-({DIRECTIONS})-\d+', code) is not None

def has_internet_route(routes):
    return any(r['destination'] == '0.0.0.0/0' and r['target'].startswith('igw-') for r in routes)

def matches_filter(policy, attributes):
    return all(name in attributes and attributes[name]['Value'] in allowed for name, allowed in policy.items())

def redrive(messages, max_receive_count):
    main = [m['id'] for m in messages if m['receive_count'] <= max_receive_count]
    dlq = [m['id'] for m in messages if m['receive_count'] > max_receive_count]
    return main, dlq

def cloud_bill(hours_used, plan_rate, on_demand_rate, committed_hours):
    return round(committed_hours * plan_rate + max(0, hours_used - committed_hours) * on_demand_rate, 2)
